asr.full_text: Hi my name is JamieGirl777 and I am doing my first YouTube video ever ever because i'm very excited about this bitconnect thing that my better half kind of showed me how to do. And then I am A big fan of Michael Crypto because my better half who is sitting here with me um kind of got me involved in we started watching his videos on BitConnect. And there's a lot of really cool, exciting happening stuff going on. So, you know, there's ways to find out how to get your Bitcoin, and then transfer it into your BitConnect wallet. And anyway, once you get your BitConnect set up after getting your Bitcoin money put into it, you're rockin'! I don't have a lot of money. I'm NOT wealthy but I'm looking to invest and try to help my kids out with their student loans and pick my life back up after some life changes. This is a really cool investment platform so got started putting well I'll show you what I did is I put in starting $100 just to get started on this because I'm you know I'm skeptical you know of any investment sur finance plataforma's I've never had the experience in doing it before so I just wanted to be careful and not put in more than I could afford to lose. So I started off with 100 bucks. Let me explain how it works really quick. When I sign on to my BitConnect dashboard it's really exciting. Every day I'll go into it just to see you know I first look at what the price of bitcoin is in the market. That if it's up, then if it's down, the more volatile it is the more action that's happening and the more exciting it gets. So that's kind of where i start. I look, if you're interested in getting on it, so it would be great if you could sign up under my referral. It kind of gives me a little boost in my investing, and you can do that as well. I will say that that's not how you make your money though. It's a perk and it helps but to make your money you just need to put a little in and then just reinvest it every time you get up to ten bucks. I will show you how and where I go to look for that. So when I sign on I first go to look there and then I go into reinvest so what I look at I'm not up there yet today but I'll look to see if I'm up to the minimum that you can invest this ten dollars so all day long I'll kind of watch it go and collect the interest and you know once about the ten dollars all you do is you just click these buttons and it know once I'm up to ten dollars all you do is just click these buttons and it'll put in just up to ten dollars. I don't have enough right now to put in, but if it was ten dollars or ten twenty one then it'll only put ten dollars. and then you just simply hit the reinvest button, takes ten dollars, and it puts it right back into your reinvesting and I'll show you that by going into here. I click on this icon, go into lending wallet. And these are all my transactions from where I first started. This is our date night. This is what we do every night. We go and we look at our investments. And it's really fun to see, you know, where you started and where you are. But I started off with $100, there's one of my rollovers, and then I got excited and put another $100 in, and another $100. So, I haven't put more than $300 in altogether just because I was excited and wanted to see how far I could push it but what it does is every day you accumulate interest from this from your Bitcoin that's fluctuating up and down in the market and as you're gaining interest for every transaction that goes through you get interest paid so this is the interest that starts to accumulate if you look at the dates like that was my investment that I rolled it over from previous, so then you kind of start off fresh with whatever you have left. So I had $1.77 left, and that day on July 27th, I had all of these accumulate in, from this point down. And then it rolled over to the next day because I didn't have $10 accumulated so on July 28th I had all these investments rolling so then that's where I am I'm waiting on you know to get to my $10 once I get to $10 then I can reinvest but my goal is is to just keep reinvesting it and there's a really good video out there that shows you The compounding interest chart, you know If you start off with 100 and approximately three and a half years if bitcoin keeps rolling the way it is You can accumulate up to two hundred fifty thousand dollars Which is a huge amount, you know, you just don't want to take any out if you went that route. A lot of people they'll go ahead take some money out once you accumulate, and you're growing more than ten dollars a day, you can go up to twenty-dollars a day, 30, 40, and once you get to a certain time point it really takes off. You know, I've seen some of these charts where people getting thousands to dollars a day. Just for an interest so when they pull it back out and uses it to pay their bills. Which is what Michael Crypto says. So it's a really good way to invest. It is going to pay off better than any investment out there. Including your banks. The other thing I look at is if you go into dashboard. If you go into Lend Bitconnect from your dashboard, this is how you can kind of check what's happening. You know if you have tons of money, which I did not, you can't really get anything back out until after 120 days, so most of us out there, you are not going to put more than a hundred to a thousand in so this is where you get your capital back after two hundred and ninety nine days if you wanted to get your hundred dollars back out of your a thousand dollars back out and then the chart goes on to show you the other capital release days. But most of us are in this bracket here so if you want to see where you know what interest you've accumulated after five days or what's gonna happen the next day this is kind of like your future crystal ball because it's gonna tell you you know tomorrow we've got one point three oh percent happening which you'll go into your compounding interest this is what happened today 1.5 four percent and this was the previous day so You can kinda see you know up and down, there's days where you won't make any and that just the way it goes. I've told myself I'm rolling with this until I start seeing negative numbers you know I don't think that's going to happen for a very long time. Another things look at here's your real time interest at here is your real-time interest charts on the real-time interest chart you can see you know how fluctuates when happiness going down it's major rollercoaster people but it's fine it's a fun ride you know you get to see what's happening in the market you can see orbit connects going up and down you know the more it's going up and down the more entrists you're making the more it's going up and down the more interest you're making the more money's going into your account um it's exciting stuff it's really exciting like i said this is our date night this is what we do every night we jump on the couch and we open up our apps and we're like let's sign into bitconnect let me see what you made you know so we're we're rolling with it and i've told a lot of my friends you know a lot of them are into the stock market they're not interested in it up until i start talking to them about this and we're going to get on the phone the next couple of days and I'm going to show them how to buy Bitcoin and then transfer it into their lending wallet and start the Bit Connect rollercoaster going so that's where we are I'm excited I hope you guys are. I'm excited. I hope you guys are, too. I keep watching Michael Crypto he's got great tips, he's full of energy, and his contest is just a it's a bit of a you know a carrot to keep rolling with this, so I won't say peace and love, that's what he says, but I'm on board. Thanks for watching! Oh Oh I just also wanted to tell you if you like this video I'm gonna start making more just to keep it real and you know maybe get some interest for the women out there that want to start putting a little bit away. Like and subscribe to my website and my link. Thank you so much.
